outcome: Adverse maternal, delivery, and neonatal events (Canadian Task Force Classification II-2)
cohort: 345 term, nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies undergoing induction of labor
finding: The EOSS may help predict the chance of cesarean delivery in nulliparous women with overweight or obesity undergoing induction of labor at term.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates increased with increasing Edmonton Obesity Staging System (EOSS) category in nulliparous women with overweight or obesity undergoing labor induction.
